text:
maria: heads-up — canary for release/rls-2026-03 is showing a 2.7x p99 on long-prompts (2k tokens) vs baseline since the kernel-selector change landed. Rolling 10% -> 50% staged; we hit the spike at ~12:20 UTC.
aj: ugh. which commit range landed the selector change?
sachin: it was the kernel-hint rework: commit d3f45a2 -> d3f45a2f (merged in rls-2026-03). CI perf looked fine locally but our canaries show KV miss rate up ~18%.
perf-bot: CI alert — perf/regressions: job=staging-inference-ci, metric=p99_tokens, delta=+160%, run=2026-03-05T11:58:09Z, details=https://ci/reports/3579
olivia: interesting that KV miss rate jumped. could hint selection be causing less KV sharing across concurrent requests?
ken: quick theory: new hint prefers per-request kernel that avoids prefetching, reduces KV reuse. That increases token compute and windowing which blows up tail latency for long sequences.
maria: can we confirm via the profiling traces? I have a snippet from canary node-7: 
```
[trace] request=abc123, kernel=fast_64, kv_hits=12, kv_misses=47, batch_size=2, p99=1324ms
[trace] request=def456, kernel=fallback_32, kv_hits=8, kv_misses=50, batch_size=1, p99=1150ms
```
aj: thanks. two quick asks: 1) start a bisect job across merges between last-green and rls-2026-03, 2) add a temporary rollout pause gate to stop at 25% if p99 increases >1.5x or token/s drops >30%.
sachin: starting bisect now — job id bisection-772. will run perf profile on each commit with a 2k-token synthetic workload. ETA ~ 45m.
olivia: for gate semantics: we should check three signals — p99, kvcache miss rate, and global tokens/sec. If any breach threshold for >5 minutes at that stage, pause rollout and notify #eng-runtime-paging. Also add an automatic rollback candidate list: if bisect shows single PR, we can auto-revert.
ken: implementation note: our rollout controller supports hooks. Patch suggestion: add this JSON to rollout config (temporary):
```
{
  "pause_conditions": [
    {"metric": "p99_latency", "factor": 1.5},
    {"metric": "tokens_per_sec", "factor": 0.7},
    {"metric": "kv_miss_rate", "absolute": 0.12}
  ],
  "window_secs": 300,
  "action_on_pause": "halt_and_notify"
}
```
aj: looks good. make sure action_on_pause can trigger an immediate canary rollback if bisect finds a single offending commit.
maria: bisect update: bisection-772 narrowed it down to PR #2384 (sachin's kernel-hint rework). Confirming with two checkpoints.
sachin: yep that aligns with my local repro. I have a minimal patch to prefer fallback kernel when batch_size<=2 or kvcache_miss_rate>0.1 — quick patch: 
```
if (batch_size <= 2 || kvcache_miss_rate > 0.1) {
  select_kernel("fallback_prefetch");
}
```
ken: can we canary that patch at 10% for 15m and see telemetry? Also add a short-circuit in the runtime to prefer older kernel if p99 starts climbing mid-request.
maria: ops: deploying rollback gate + patch to canary in parallel. I'm toggling rollout controller to 10% and adding the JSON. curl to toggle:
```
curl -X POST "$ROLLOUT_CTRL/api/v1/stages/rls-2026-03/pause-config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @pause.json
```
olivia: add dashboard links to the alert: p99-longprompts, kv-miss-rate, tokens-per-second. Also update runbook with steps to escalate to SRE if automatic rollback triggers.
perf-bot: monitoring started — watchlist: p99_longprompts, kv_miss, tokens_per_sec.
aj: if the patch mitigates, we can continue rollout. if not, we should auto-revert PR #2384 and run a follow-up that reworks hinting with a focus on cache locality.
sachin: I'll prepare the revert PR now and hold off merging until bisect finishes and canary stabilizes.
ken: small follow-up: let's add a lightweight regression test in CI that simulates long prompts and checks kvcache_miss_rate delta relative to baseline to catch this earlier.
maria: agreed. action items: 1) sachin — revert PR #2384 candidate + publish patch (ETA 20m). 2) ken — open CI test issue and rollout-config PR for permanent pause thresholds. 3) olivia — update runbook and dashboards. 4) aj — monitor bisect and canary telemetry, call pager if auto-pause triggers.
olivia: tagging oncall: @sre-oncall FYI — might need to help if automatic rollback fires. :alert: 
aj: thanks team. will post updates in this thread.
maria: closing loop — at 15m canary looks back to baseline after the fallback-prefetch policy applied. p99 down to 1.03x baseline, kv_miss_rate back near baseline. I'll leave rollout paused until we ship the proper patch + CI test. :thumbsup:
ken: good outcome. let's follow up with a postmortem blameless doc once we finish the revert vs rework decision.
